title: Spatial Prepositions - Position & Location
description: Learn to describe where things are: devant (in front of), derrière (behind), entre (between), au-dessus (above), au-dessous (below)
can_do: Describe precise locations (in front of, behind, between)
Say 'The café is in front of the park' in French

vocabulary.note: use '{et}' to connect: entre A et B

concepts.definition: Indicates position in front of something
concepts.example: {Je suis devant la porte} (I'm in front of the door), {La voiture est devant la maison} (The car is in front of the house)
{Le chat est derrière le sofa} (The cat is behind the sofa), {Il est derrière moi} (He's behind me)
{Le café est entre l'école et le parc} (The café is between the school and the park), {Entre toi et moi} (Between you and me)

concepts.definition: Indicates being among multiple things or people
concepts.example: {Parmi les étudiants} (Among the students), {Il est parmi nous} (He's among us)
{Le tableau est au-dessus de la table} (The painting is above the table), {Au-dessus de la ville} (Above the city)
{au-dessous de nous} (below us), {Le parking est au-dessous} (The parking is below)

concepts.definition: Reinforce: dans (in/inside), sur (on/on top of), sous (under/beneath)
concepts.example: {Le livre est dans le sac} (in the bag), {sur la table} (on the table), {sous la table} (under the table)

items.gloss: I'm in front of the door

mistakes.feedback: Derrière means 'behind'. Use '{devant}' for 'in front of'!
Dans means 'in/inside'. Use '{devant}' for 'in front of'!

items.gloss: The cat is behind the sofa

mistakes.feedback: Devant means 'in front of'. Use '{derrière}' for 'behind'!
Sous means 'under'. Use '{derrière}' for 'behind' (back side)!

items.text: Le café est ___ l'école et le parc
items.gloss: The café is between the school and the park

mistakes.feedback: Parmi means 'among' (many things). Use '{entre}' for 'between' two things!
Dans means 'in/inside'. Use '{entre}' for 'between' two places!

items.gloss: The painting is above the table

mistakes.feedback: Au-dessous means 'below'. Use '{au-dessus de}' for 'above'!
Sur means 'on' (touching). Use '{au-dessus de}' for 'above' (not touching)!

items.gloss: Among the students, there are French people

mistakes.feedback: Entre is for TWO things. Use '{parmi}' for 'among' many things!
Dans means 'in/inside'. Use '{parmi}' for 'among' a group!
Au-dessus means 'above'. Use '{au-dessous}' for 'below'!
Sous needs a noun after it: '{sous la maison}'. Use '{au-dessous}' alone!

items.gloss: The book is in the bag/inside the bag

mistakes.feedback: Sur means 'on top of'. Use '{dans}' for 'in/inside' something!
Devant means 'in front of'. Use '{dans}' for 'in/inside'!

items.gloss: My phone is on the table

mistakes.feedback: Dans means 'in/inside'. Use '{sur}' for 'on top of' a surface!
Au-dessus means 'above' (not touching). Use '{sur}' for '{on}' (touching)!

items.gloss: The dog is under the table

mistakes.feedback: Sur means 'on top of'. Use '{sous}' for 'under/beneath'!
Au-dessous is for 'below' in levels. Use '{sous}' for 'under' physically!

items.text: ___ toi et moi, c'est un secret
items.gloss: Between you and me, it's a secret

mistakes.feedback: Parmi is for many things. Use '{entre}' for 'between' two people!
Avec means 'with'. Use '{entre}' for 'between'!

items.text: Il y a un jardin ___ la maison
items.gloss: There's a garden behind the house

mistakes.feedback: Devant means 'in front of'. Use '{derrière}' for 'behind/in back'!
Dans means 'in/inside'. Use '{derrière}' for 'behind/in back'!
Sur means 'on' (touching). Use '{au-dessus de}' for 'above' (hanging)!
Devant means 'in front of'. Use '{au-dessus de}' for 'above'!

items.gloss: He's sitting in front of me/facing me

mistakes.feedback: Derrière means 'behind'. Use '{devant}' for 'in front of/facing'!
Avec means 'with'. Use '{devant}' for 'in front of'!

items.gloss: Among us, there's a good teacher

mistakes.feedback: Entre is for between TWO. Use '{parmi}' for 'among' a group!
Avec means 'with'. Use '{parmi}' for 'among'!
Au-dessus means 'above/upstairs'. Use '{au-dessous}' for 'below/downstairs'!
En bas works too! But we're learning '{au-dessous}' here.

items.gloss: The cat is under the car

mistakes.feedback: Sur means 'on top of'. Use '{sous}' for 'under/beneath'!
Dans means 'in/inside'. Use '{sous}' for 'under/beneath'!

items.text: Il y a un arbre ___ ma fenêtre
items.gloss: There's a tree in front of my window

mistakes.feedback: Derrière means 'behind'. Use '{devant}' for 'in front of'!
Entre is for 'between' two things. Use '{devant}' for 'in front of'!

items.gloss: Your book is among my books

mistakes.feedback: Entre is for between TWO specific things. Use '{parmi}' for among many!
Dans means 'in/inside'. Use '{parmi}' for 'among' a group!
